IONQ.entry_thesis: Quantum internet infrastructure layer. Networked qubits demonstrated. $130M revenue +200% YoY. DARPA/NVIDIA/AstraZeneca partnerships.
IONQ.kill_criteria: Revenue growth <50% YoY OR major contract loss OR competitor achieves networked quantum advantage first

MP.entry_thesis: Only US rare earth magnet producer. DoD + Apple contracts. China controls 80% of global rare earth supply — geopolitical moat is structural.

milestones.name: GM or major automaker delivery expansion

MP.kill_criteria: Loss of DoD or Apple contract OR US-China rare earth deal that opens supply

SOUN.entry_thesis: AI voice platform — $84M revenue +90% YoY. The missing UI layer for the LLM era. NVIDIA equity stake. Sticky automotive (Hyundai, Stellantis) + restaurant (Chipotle, White Castle) ARR.
SOUN.kill_criteria: Revenue growth decelerates below 40% YoY OR NVIDIA fully exits stake OR major OEM customer churns
SOUN.notes: Size small — do not chase above $8. Entry on dips only.

LUNR.entry_thesis: NASA lunar infrastructure — $200M+ Artemis contracts. Only public pure-play on the lunar economy. IM-2 already flew. Government-contracted revenue, not speculation.
LUNR.kill_criteria: Mission failure AND contract loss OR Artemis program budget cut >50%
LUNR.notes: Customer concentration risk: NASA ~80% of revenue. Political risk on Artemis.

RXRX.entry_thesis: AI drug discovery platform. $12B Roche/Genentech milestone pipeline. 23PB irreplaceable biological imaging data — took 10 years and $500M+ to build, cannot be replicated.

milestones.name: New pharma partnership or milestone payment

RXRX.kill_criteria: Two consecutive Phase 2 clinical failures OR Roche partnership cancelled OR NVIDIA exits investment
RXRX.notes: Downsized to 1% — on probation until Phase 2 readouts. Quarterly review required.

ASTS.entry_thesis: Satellite-to-phone internet via AT&T/Verizon/Vodafone. 2.8B existing subscribers work without switching. BlueBird satellites delivering 4G/5G to unmodified phones.
ASTS.kill_criteria: Multiple launch failures AND major carrier (AT&T or Verizon) exits agreement
ASTS.notes: Binary moonshot slot. Hard cap 1% regardless of confidence. Hold through vol.
